name: Fundo de Investimento Imobiliario Projeto Agua Branca
summary: Fundo de Investimento Imobiliário Projeto Água Branca is a real estate investment trust. It engages in investment and management of properties. The firm's portfolio primarily includes office buildings. Fundo de Investimento Imobiliário Projeto Água Branca was formed on 1st of May 1998 and is based in São Paulo, Brazil.
